newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 50,000 T French wheat at $147/T fob.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 50,000 T French wheat at $147/T fob.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Saturday he had bought 50,000 tonnes of French soft red wheat at $147 per tonne fob.
Samir Shakankiri, vice chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters the period of shipment was between November 30 and December 6.
Shakankiri said earlier on Saturday he was seeking 100,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat for loading from December 12 to 31. The deadline for the bids is 1100 GMT on November 14.
He tendered on Friday for 50,000 tonnes of American soft red or soft white wheat for loading from November 18 to 30. The tender will be decided later on Saturday.
